_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to tranches.json and populate with your actual positions. Tranche classification defines exit logic per holding.

tranche_types.thematic_core: Long-horizon position (multi-quarter to multi-year). Sized to thesis confidence. Hold through noise; only trim on thesis break or extreme overweight.
tranche_types.event_trade: Pre-positioned for a specific catalyst (earnings, regulatory, contract). Sized larger than thematic-core target. Exit-by-rule after catalyst resolves (see event_trades.json).
tranche_types.catalyst_concentration_overlay: Catalyst-specific position add on TOP of thematic_core. Sized aggressively (often breaching single-name caps). Exit-by-pre-committed rule mechanically post-catalyst.
tranche_types.tactical_swing: Short-cycle position based on sentiment / technical / sector rotation. Hard time-stop (e.g., 30 days).

default_exit_logic.thematic_core: Don't trim on news that confirms the thesis. Trim on thesis break or if weight exceeds 1.5× target.
default_exit_logic.event_trade: Trim 50–70% into post-catalyst gap-up; full exit on miss; see event_trades.json for rules per trade.
default_exit_logic.catalyst_concentration_overlay: Mechanical execution per pre-committed scenario matrix in event_trades.json. NO discretionary deviation.
default_exit_logic.tactical_swing: Hard time-stop, ATR-based exits, accept choppy P&L.

thesis_break_triggers: Concrete observable that would invalidate the thesis (e.g., 'GM compression below X%')
Industry-level event (e.g., 'major competitor in-house silicon launch at scale')

EXAMPLE_C.thesis_short: Why this is pre-positioned for the catalyst
EXAMPLE_C.post_event_default: Per pre-committed exit rules. Default = full exit by Friday post-print. Optional thematic core conversion only if thesis case persists.

exited_positions_log.exit_rationale: Why the position was exited — thesis break / capital reallocation / drawdown tier breach / catalyst out of window / etc.

concentration_targets_summary.note: Free-text concentration narrative. Flag intentional cap breaches vs unintentional drift.
